description:
Changes an existing task: name, duration, type, scheduling constraint, deadline, notes, position, or three-point estimate (optimistic/pessimistic, used by the Monte Carlo simulation), then recalculates the dependent dates. The previous values are overwritten.
Constraints follow MS Project: asap, alap, start_no_earlier_than, start_no_later_than, finish_no_earlier_than, finish_no_later_than, must_start_on, must_finish_on; all but asap/alap need constraintDate.
For progress use planitude_set_progress. Requires write permission.

constraintDate.description: Constraint date in ISO 8601 with offset. null clears it.

deadline.description: Deadline in ISO 8601 with offset. null removes it.

durationMinutes.description: New duration in working minutes. Takes precedence over durationDays.

optimisticDays.description: Three-point estimate: optimistic duration in working days (Monte Carlo only). null removes it.

parentTask.description: Move under this task as its subtask. To move it out one level use planitude_outdent_task.

pessimisticDays.description: Three-point estimate: pessimistic duration in working days. null removes it (the project default range applies).

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

task.description: Task reference: its key (the 'rif' column, e.g. 'Cronos-12'), its uuid, 'wbs:1.2', or its exact name if unique.

wbs.description: New WBS code. null clears it.

name: planitude_update_task
title: Update task
